rows.ProposalDescription1:
This proposal is based on plans prepared by: Juniper, sheets L1-01 thru L1-04, Dated: October 14, 2024.

(10-7-25 updated pricing w-lighting revision)

LANDSCAPE NOTES: This proposal reflects the take-off quantities shown on the plans. Shortages and undersized plant material are common in the landscaping industry due to current market conditions; therefore, height of shrubs per required container size cannot be guaranteed. This proposal may include increased container sizes to meet the requested specifications shown on the plant schedule. An add/deduct price can be provided for an additional cost. Multi-trunk Palm CT/GW/HT measurement based on the shortest truck. Mulch shall be Cocoa Brown & Pine Straw per schedule. This proposal does not include tree protection, herbicide, root barrier, or soil remediation.

Material Availability Notes: Royal Palm has limited availability. May need to substitute with 4’ gw ht, Christmas Palm has limited availability. May need to substitute with 10-12’ ht, Silver Buttonwood & Bleeding Heart Vine have limited availability.


SOD NOTES: Sod shall be Floratam per the schedule. Sod quantities are estimated. The actual quantity used may be different.

  • The contractor may request additional areas for sod to be installed at the same square foot price contracted through this scope of work.

  • A color-out attachment has been provided to show sod areas Juniper has included in this proposal.


LIGHTING NOTES: Electrical outlet for transformers to be provided by others.


IRRIGATION NOTES: Irrigation estimate based on Juniper Design/Build. Water source has been determined and defined within the civil plans as Potable 1.5” metered water source providing 75 GPM @ 60 PSI. The irrigation price does not include the price of a backflow. Juniper does not install backflows. This should be installed by a certified plumber. Desired location of the irrigation controller was not available at time of estimate. Power to irrigation controller to be provided by others. All Landscape is hydro-zoned.
